nodes.description: uint16 constant maximum token supply (180) used to bound minting in ownerMint and mint.
uint256 constant mint price (0.01 ether) validated against msg.value in mint().
Public string base URI for token metadata, written by setBaseURI and read by tokenURI.
Private mapping(address=>bool) tracking whitelisted addresses, read in whitelistOnly modifier and written by addWhitelist/removeWhitelist.
Private mapping(address=>bool) tracking addresses that already minted, read and written in mint().
Private MintState enum controlling whether minting is PUBLIC, WHITELIST or CLOSED; gates mint() and is set by setMintingState.
Initializes ERC721A name/symbol ('SwapStreet Beta Tester','SSBT') for SwapStreetNFT.
Overridden hook returning 1 as the first token id.
onlyOwner setter that writes the metadata base URI into baseURI.
View function returning baseURI + tokenId + '.json' after an existence check.
onlyOwner function adding an array of addresses to the _whitelisted mapping.
onlyOwner function removing an array of addresses from the _whitelisted mapping.
onlyOwner function minting 'amount' tokens to the caller after a MAX_SUPPLY range check via _safeMint.
Payable nonReentrant whitelist-only mint that enforces one-per-address, MAX_SUPPLY and exact PRICE, then calls _safeMint.
onlyOwner function updating the mintingState enum controlling the mint phase.
Caller-controlled address used for whitelist checks, minted flags, ownership and mint recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp stored in TokenOwnership.startTimestamp during mint/transfer/burn.
_safeMint path that, for contract recipients, performs an external onERC721Received callback before finalizing state.
Untrusted external call to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received in _checkContractOnERC721Received, enabling reentrancy into mint/transfer.
require(owner()==_msgSender()) authorization gate applied to privileged functions.
uint16 amount parameter of ownerMint().
calldata string _uri parameter of setBaseURI().
uint256 tokenId parameter of tokenURI().
calldata address[] parameter of addWhitelist()/removeWhitelist().
MintState enum parameter of setMintingState().
Local variable caching totalSupply() inside ownerMint().

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller whose identity drives the whitelistOnly gate and becomes the mint recipient in mint().
msg.sender indexes the _whitelisted mapping inside the whitelistOnly modifier.
msg.sender indexes and finally sets _minted[msg.sender] in mint().
mintingState enum gates execution of mint() via the whitelistOnly modifier check.
setMintingState writes the mintingState enum that controls mint availability.
onlyOwner authorization gate must pass before setBaseURI executes.
onlyOwner authorization gate must pass before addWhitelist executes.
onlyOwner authorization gate must pass before removeWhitelist executes.
onlyOwner authorization gate must pass before ownerMint executes.
onlyOwner authorization gate must pass before setMintingState executes.
mint() calls _safeMint, which can hand control to an untrusted contract recipient before mint state is finalized.
ownerMint() calls _safeMint, which may invoke the external recipient callback.
The _safeMint path invokes the external onERC721Received call, creating the reentrancy surface.
block.timestamp is recorded as ownership startTimestamp during the mint flow, making timestamps miner-influenced state.
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the totalSupply + amount arithmetic check in ownerMint().
MAX_SUPPLY is compared against totalSupply() to limit minting in mint().
PRICE is compared against msg.value in mint() to enforce exact payment.
setBaseURI writes the owner-supplied URI into baseURI.
tokenURI reads baseURI to construct the metadata URI.
ownerMint computes the totalSupply() local variable used in its supply check.
The untrusted owner-supplied amount drives totalSupply + amount and the minted quantity in ownerMint().
The _uri parameter is assigned directly into the baseURI state variable.
The tokenId parameter is used for the existence check and string concatenation in tokenURI.
The addresses array is iterated to set _whitelisted entries in addWhitelist.
The addresses array is iterated to clear _whitelisted entries in removeWhitelist.
The state parameter directly overwrites the mintingState enum in setMintingState.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to drive the ownerMint supply arithmetic and _safeMint quantity, so it collapses into that function.
The _uri parameter is only used to assign baseURI within setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is only consumed inside tokenURI for existence checks and URI construction.
The addresses array is only iterated to populate _whitelisted inside the whitelist-management function; primary merge target is addWhitelist.
The state enum parameter exists solely to overwrite mintingState inside setMintingState.
The totalSupply local is a transient cache used only for the MAX_SUPPLY comparison inside ownerMint.
